SENDCLOUD.test: Test mode: the TEST pickup answers at once; nothing is booked.

PHONE.title: Booked by phone

eod.title: End of day

eod.lead: Each carrier's sheet lists what it took today; the driver signs the printed manifest.

handOver.body: For goods leaving with our own van or a carrier booked by hand: each shipment is marked as left, one by one. A shipment the customer's own carrier collects is done in the shipment itself.
